TITLE: Project Blue - Ginger Ale Menthol with K Blend 85mm vs
Ginger Ale Menthol with Marlboro Blend 85mm
PURPOSE: To determine acceptability of Ginger Ale Menthol with
Marlboro Blend 85mm vs Ginger Ale Menthol with K Blend 85mm
ANALYTICAL SUMMARY: The Ginger Ale Menthol with Marlboro Blend 85mm
cigarettes were different from the Ginger Ale Menthol with K Biend
85mm cigarettes in puff count, static burning time, ventilation,
total alkaloids and reducing sugars, tobacco weight, and rod density.
COMMENTS: This test is part of the Project Blue Phase I testing.
The results have been summarized in a memo.*
PLANS: The K Blend with Creme Flavoring will be tested against Kool,
Salem, and Newport among the respective smokers of those brands.
*Memo to Ms. J. Smith from M. Fleming, dated May 19, 1986,
